title: Utrums pvp overlay (no gui)
description: A clean PvP-focused resource pack for Minecraft 1.21+ with custom sword textures, shield designs, modified sounds, and visual improvements to help you perform better in combat.
body:
Here’s what this pack offers

close sodium particles in settings for best experience 
- Animated items, smooth, captivating animation’s 
- Side-positioned shield, shifts the shield to the side for clearer screen space
- Classic enchantment glint (pre-1.19.4), brings back the old, nostalgic shimmer
- Smaller totem pop + particles, less visual clutter during totem activations
- Optimized for performance, lightweight and runs smoothly on most setups
- Supports **Minecraft 1.20.1 – 1.21+**, fully compatible with the latest versions.                      -short sword for better visibility.                         -no fire
-better end crystal+no particles
Features:

Custom sword textures (all tiers)
Redesigned shield textures
Modified explosion & rain particles
Cleaner fire & water visuals
Custom hurt/explosion sounds
OptiFine lightmap support
Supports Minecraft 1.21+
